messages:
alex: Quick async update + ask — token-cost attribution work. Goal: land final event schema + attribution mapping by EOD Friday so finance can run POC. Can owners please confirm status and blockers?

maria: I can own the schema PR (will open today). Need confirmation on latency fields and whether we include per-route tags.

jordan: thanks @maria. Pipeline change (kafka->batch-transform) is in review, but it depends on the schema field names. I can unblock once schema is final. PR linked: https://git.internal/repo/pipeline/pull/412 :eyes:

alex: @jordan noted. timeline wise — if pipeline PR merges Tue, we can do a staged rollout Wed-Thu, then finance smoke Fri. If either PR slips, we push.

maria: Draft schema below (first pass). open to bikeshedding names.

maria: ```json
{
  "event_type": "token_cost_attribution",
  "timestamp": "ISO8601",
  "request_id": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "tokens_input": "int",
  "tokens_output": "int",
  "cost_usd": "float",
  "latency_ms": "int",
  "route": "string",
  "client_id": "string",
  "env": "string",
  "sampled": "bool"
}
```

eva: Quick thought — can we split latency_ms into `server_latency_ms` and `inference_latency_ms`? We currently surface both in the console. If we only send one, we lose granularity for SLO alerts. :thinking_face:

maria: Good call. I'll add both fields and mark them optional for older clients.

samir: For rollout: plan to gate on a feature flag in the serving runtime. Steps: (1) schema PR merged, (2) pipeline PR merged, (3) deploy transform that writes new event, (4) enable flag for 10% traffic, (5) monitor dashboards 24h, (6) ramp. I can own deployment steps.

jordan: FYI pipeline-bot ran a dry-run and reported schema conflicts with existing topic schema v2. pipeline-bot: "found 2 incompatible fields: latency_ms type(int) vs string in v2; route missing". Need to reconcile before merge.

pipeline-bot: [automated] dry-run results: incompatible with topic token-usage-v2. See CI artifact: https://ci.internal/builds/8673/artifact.json

alex: OK, action items then: @maria update schema (add server_latency_ms & inference_latency_ms, mark backward-compat opts), @jordan resolve pipeline dry-run errors (help from @samir if needed), @samir to prepare rollouts + dashboards (add cost-per-route panels).

maria: Will push schema PR in ~2h and add a short summary of compatibility strategy in PR description.

jordan: I'll re-run transform tests after schema update and post results here.

eva: Can someone add the route-level SLO thresholds to the dashboard? I can review once you add panels.

samir: Will add panels, including a per-client cost spike alert (thresholds TBD). tagging @eva for review. :white_check_mark:

alex: One more ask — finance wants a stub mapping from event to per-feature cost. @maria can you add a `feature_flag` optional field so we can tie tokens to features in early POC?

maria: Yep adding `feature_flag` optional string now.

jordan: tests green after schema update. pushing pipeline PR for final review.

pipeline-bot: [automated] pipeline PR build succeeded — all tests passed.

alex: Awesome. Let's keep cadence: update status here once PRs are merged. If anything blocks EOD Friday, call emergency sync. Thanks all. :rocket:
